caption:
Musinsa third-quarter operating profit jumps 67% on foreign shopper spending

Revenue rose 34.2 percent to 405.8 billion won ($303 million), and operating profit reached 19.6 billion won. Foreign-card spending at Musinsa's multibrand stores nearly tripled, and its global online business continued to post triple-digit growth. Transaction value across its 17 directly operated multibrand stores rose 203 percent on-year in July to September.

Reported by The Korea Herald.
